description: This file defines classes for loading trace data either from ZIP archives or via fetch requests, implementing the TraceLoaderBackend interface.

classes.name: ZipTraceLoaderBackend
classes.description: Class for loading trace data from ZIP archives using zip.js.

classes.name: FetchTraceLoaderBackend
classes.description: Class for loading trace data via fetch API, handling JSON entries.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the loader with a trace URI and progress callback.

methods.name: _resolveTraceURI
methods.description: Resolves Dropbox URLs to direct download links.

methods.name: isLive
methods.description: Indicates whether the backend is live; returns false for Zip, true for Fetch.

methods.name: entryNames
methods.description: Returns a list of entry names available in the trace.

methods.name: hasEntry
methods.description: Checks if a specific entry exists.

methods.name: readText
methods.description: Reads the content of an entry as text.

methods.name: readBlob
methods.description: Reads the content of an entry as a Blob.
